title: Samsung RF28 — Load condition display
description: Fridge + FlexZone 6 s then Freezer key — shows MICOM load outputs 30 s.

steps.title: Enter load condition mode
steps.body: Fridge + FlexZone 6 s (all segments blink 4 s). Press Freezer key — commanded loads blink 0.5 s for 30 s.
